transitions.operation_detail: Single cells are lysed and mRNA is reverse transcribed with the barcoded RT primer (Ad-1x) carrying a 5' handle, T7 promoter, RA5 adapter, cell barcode and anchored poly-T; gDNA is not separated and passes through unchanged.

MALBAC-type quasilinear amplification of gDNA and first-strand cDNA together using the MALBAC random primers, producing amplicons with Ad-2 at one end (dead end), Ad-2 at both ends (PCR-competent) and, for cDNA, Ad-2 at one end with Ad-1x at the other (IVT-competent).

After seven quasilinear amplification cycles, the unsplit mixture is divided into equal gDNA-processing and RNA-processing aliquots; each aliquot retains the carried Ad-2/Ad-2 and Ad-2/Ad-1x molecular classes.
One half of the split reaction is amplified with the MALBAC PCR primer; cDNA-derived amplicons carrying Ad-2 at both ends are co-amplified and later read as gDNA.
A second PCR with 5-prime-biotinylated primer P3 tags the Ad-2-containing termini before sonication.
The P3-biotin-tagged PCR product was sheared by sonication, purified, and verified at an average product size of approximately 300 bp.

The sheared products were incubated with Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin C1; biotinylated terminal fragments were immobilized, and the combined non-biotinylated supernatant and washes were carried forward.

major_reagents.name: NEBNext Ultra DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina

transitions.operation_detail: The Ad-2-depleted genomic DNA was converted to an indexed Illumina library with the NEBNext Ultra DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina; the packet does not print the kit adapter architecture or index-primer sequences.

The other half of the split reaction undergoes second-strand synthesis with the 2nd strand primer, which anneals to the Ad-1x-derived 3' end and regenerates a double-stranded, IVT-competent T7 promoter.
In vitro transcription from the double-stranded T7 promoter linearly amplifies the cDNA as aRNA; cleanup is folded into this transition.

aRNA is cleaned up WITHOUT fragmentation, then 3' Illumina adaptors (RA3) are ligated to the intact runoff transcript, followed by reverse transcription and indexed PCR. Library construction is delegated to CEL-Seq (Hashimshony et al. 2012) and is modelled as one collapsed transition; the CEL-Seq source is not in this packet.
